shared_validation.purpose: read-only validation of accepted slice1 (103-test suite); never imports a candidate framework

python.note: All candidate wheels require Python >=3.10; the shared 3.9 venv cannot and must not run them.

agent_framework.purpose: Microsoft Agent Framework adapter execution + focused/cross/failure tests

disposable_venvs.never_coinstalled: LangGraph and Agent Framework live in separate disposable venvs; cross-candidate tests invoke each exact interpreter as a subprocess and compare shared JSON-normalized results.

langgraph_security_minimums.policy: Versions pinned exceed all four published patched minimums.
langgraph_security_minimums.advisories_covered: msgpack deserialization, checkpoint JSON RCE, SQLite metadata-key injection

static_metadata_allowlist.enforced: verify_checkpoint_identity rejects any non-allowlisted metadata key
static_metadata_allowlist.run_id_binding: required present + must equal contract.run_id (missing is failure)

agent_framework_controls.checkpoint_codec: spike-owned StrictJsonCheckpointStorage; rejects unsupported values, non-string keys, NaN/Infinity, and recursive/cyclic structures before any file write
agent_framework_controls.pickle: adapter adds zero pickle refs; framework's internal FileCheckpointStorage uses a pickle envelope for WorkflowMessage routing (worker_03 residual note); the spike StrictJsonCheckpointStorage avoids this
agent_framework_controls.no_provider_dependency: deterministic executors only; no model/provider/Foundry/client instantiation

privacy_data_egress_boundary.services: no services started, no ports listened
privacy_data_egress_boundary.persistence: all runtime products land in pytest tmp_path dirs; checkpoint DB/files separate from authoritative Store

reversibility.disposable_venvs: evidence only; move to Trash after acceptance
reversibility.product_state: no changes to product, medical-writing, accepted slice1, shared .venv, lockfiles, or config
